summary: ERLING ROLSTAD STEIN AS (org. no. 813 724 952) is a private limited company (AS) based in Nord-Fron, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2014-06-05. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 08.120 (Utvinning fra grus- og sandtak, og utvinning av leire og kaolin); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 4.9 m. CEO: Egil Rolstad; board chair: Egil Rolstad; auditor: BDO AS.
